description.p: RYZ Authenticator is a native, ultra-lightweight (~30 MB RAM), zero-knowledge Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) application built in Rust and Tauri 2.0. It encrypts all TOTP and HOTP secrets using XChaCha20-Poly1305 and Argon2id, supports live webcam/phone QR scanning, 1-step Google Authenticator migration import, and encrypted offline backups.
Multi-platform live camera QR scanner, Base32 secret validator, brute-force protection, and E2EE cloud sync.
